description: In handle_mailbox_set (mailbox.rs:682 and 696), when onDestroyRemoveEmails=true the cascade loop that destroys or patches emails uses 'Err(BackendSetError::SetError(_)) => {}' — swallowing the per-email error without any logging or reporting. If the backend rejects the email destroy/update (e.g. returns Forbidden), the error is silently dropped, the mailbox destroy then proceeds, and the response claims success. This leaves the data in a partially-mutated state with no client-visible indication. Maintenance consequence: impossible to diagnose cascade failures in production; partial mutations are invisible.
title: onDestroyRemoveEmails cascade silently ignores SetError from email ops
